name: ZCode
summary: 智谱的 agent 编程桌面应用：查看会话、状态和完整对话；使用 API Key 添加的模型时可从手机发消息、确认、回答提问和中断
summaryEn: Zhipu's agentic coding desktop app: view sessions, status and full conversations; with models added using an API key, send messages, confirm, answer questions and interrupt from your phone

limitsNote: ZCode 配合的 GLM Coding Plan 额度（5 小时、每周）只能在智谱网页上查看，本机不记录，「今日用量」中不显示；token 按 ZCode 自己的记录统计
limitsNoteEn: The GLM Coding Plan quota used with ZCode (5-hour and weekly) can only be checked on Zhipu's website and isn't recorded on your computer, so it isn't shown under Today's usage. Tokens are counted from ZCode's own records
speaker: ZCode
notes: 使用 ZCode 账号登录的模型的会话改为只读并说明原因（之前从手机发消息会没有反应）；从手机发起的这一轮失败时在对话里提示原因；提示改为「退出 ZCode 再打开就能看到」。
notesEn: Sessions using a model from your ZCode account sign-in are now view-only with an explanation (sending from your phone used to do nothing); if a turn from your phone fails, the conversation says why; the hint now says to quit and reopen ZCode to see the turn.

gaps.text: 使用 ZCode 账号登录的模型（如 GLM Coding Plan）的会话只能查看：这类模型要由 ZCode 桌面版提供登录状态，要从手机操作就得读 ZCode 的登录凭证，这里不做。在 ZCode 设置里用 API Key 添加的模型可以从手机操作
gaps.textEn: Sessions using a model from your ZCode account sign-in (such as the GLM Coding Plan) are view-only: those models need the ZCode desktop app's sign-in, and controlling them from your phone would mean reading ZCode's sign-in credentials, which Kiteline doesn't do. Models added with an API key in ZCode's settings can be controlled from your phone

gaps.text: 电脑上的 ZCode 窗口里发起的那一轮，它要确认的命令、要回答的提问只弹在电脑上，手机上处理不了：那一轮在 ZCode 桌面版自己的进程里，Kiteline 收不到
gaps.textEn: For turns started in the ZCode window on your computer, command confirmations and questions only appear on your computer and can't be handled from your phone: those turns run inside the ZCode desktop app's own process, which Kiteline can't reach

gaps.text: 电脑上发起的那一轮也不能从手机中断（同上）；从手机发起的那一轮可以
gaps.textEn: Turns started on your computer can't be interrupted from your phone either (same reason); turns started from your phone can

gaps.text: 电脑上的 ZCode 窗口不会实时显示从手机发起的那一轮（切换对话也不刷新），退出 ZCode 再打开就能看到
gaps.textEn: The ZCode window on your computer doesn't show turns started from your phone as they happen (switching conversations doesn't refresh it); quit and reopen ZCode to see them
